nonblocking_findings: N1 [Medium] ball presets: the orangewhite ball does not read orange (out/chibi-sprouts/r1/props/presets/orangewhite/ball/three-quarter.png; out/ball/render.orangewhite.png). The panel A mean of that cutout is #f6c55f (hue 41, S 61, V 96). The brief value #e8892c is hue 30, S 81, V 91. The default yellow panel B averages #dfb649 (hue 44), so the orange and the yellow read as one gold. Two more presets drift. greenyellow A is #65ee85 (hue 134, V 93) against #4f9a4a (hue 116, V 60). purplewhite A is #8e7af5 (hue 250) against #7b4a9e (hue 275). bluewhite A is #60a2f7 (hue 214, V 97): the hue is right and the value is lighter than #3f6fa8. The default red averages #f2726d against #d9443a, the same pale lift that the accepted paint splash showed. The unlit atlases show the same drift (out/ball/textures/baseColor.orangewhite.png holds #e8b840 as its main panel colour, greenyellow #50c868, purplewhite #7860e0). The cause fits the recolour rule in docs/color-variants.md: each channel is multiplied by option over default in linear light. The red default has G 0.058 and B 0.042, so the ratios reach 9. I did not instrument the bake. The row of five balls on grass still reads colourful (red, blue, green, gold, violet), so the book line W2 holds. The PM value orange does not. Suggested change: pick the option values so the baked panel means land on the target hues, as the splash round did with measured means, then re-cut presets/bluewhite, greenyellow, orangewhite, and purplewhite. | owner: maker (measure-jr-green); the PM decides

N2 [Medium] kite presets: the red kite and the yellow kite are not one colour each (out/chibi-sprouts/r1/props/presets/red/kite/front.png and presets/yellow/kite/front.png). In the red front cutout the top-right quarter averages #f45769 (hue 353, rose). The other three average #f46862, #f4564f, and #f4574e (hue 3). In the yellow front cutout the top-left quarter averages #f7f460 (hue 59, lemon). The other three average #f8cd63, #f8ca54, and #f8ce54 (hue 43 to 45). A thin lime line also runs along the lemon quarter and the lower-right quarter in the yellow cutout. The composite of the three kites on sky blue shows both defects at a glance. The book line W2 says one red kite and one yellow kite. The cause fits the recolour rule: sailA goes from red to yellow with a G ratio of 9.3, and sailB goes from yellow to red with a B ratio of 1.4. The default redyellow kite is clean (quarters #f46862, #f8cd63, #f8ca54, #f4574e). Suggested change: tune the option values with measured quarter means, or cut the red and the yellow kite from sources whose default equals the preset, then re-cut presets/red and presets/yellow. | owner: maker (measure-jr-green); the PM decides

N3 [Low] brush paint tip is small (out/chibi-sprouts/r1/props/brush/front.png and presets/purple/brush/front.png). The pink pixels (hue 255 to 345, S 25 percent or more) number 76, in a patch of 9 columns by 12 rows at 1024 px/m. The bounding box is 45 by 174 px, so the paint is about 1 percent of it. At the stage scale of 556 px/m the tip is about 5 by 6 px. The colours are right: pink #e37dad against #e87fb0, and purple #925ab9 against #8e5bb5. Nothing else is red: 0 pixels with hue 340 to 14 degrees, S 45 percent or more, and V 35 percent or more, in all four brush cutouts. In out/brush/render.png, render.purple.png, and the card, the brush also reads as a fat pencil: a straight wood shaft, then a short cream cone that ends in a coloured point. The geometry is unchanged from the first batch, and the order asked for a colour change only. Pink against purple is the W3 content, so a larger paint wash would help. Suggested change (optional): extend the paint wash from 12 mm to about 25 mm, or give the bristles a belly. | owner: maker (measure-jr-green); the PM decides
